_about: Fill from the plan checkpoint before writing code. Keys: policy, rails, decoupling, buses, connectors, jumpers, test_points, bringup, margin, accepted_warns. See <skill>/reference/checks-config.md.

policy._about: the brief's numbers; copy them here at the plan checkpoint and do not lower them to make a tool read 0 (R1-A2-T5)

refplane._why: Alex's stackup: In1 and In2 both solid GND, rails routed, every signal over unbroken ground (REFPLANE-1); the limit follows the net's bucket in `signals`

return_via._why: a via on a bucket-3 net needs a GND via within 2 mm (SIG-2)

exposure._why: same-layer track beside the switch node, victims weighted (SIG-3)

signals._about: SIG-1: per signal net, the driver's edge and where the number comes from; `pcb signals checks.json --netlist x.xml` computes the knee (0.5 / t_rise) and bucket (1 <1 MHz, 2 1-50, 3 50-500, 4 >=500) and lists the nets left out. t_rise_ns null = DC. victim = analog, high impedance: wants distance from aggressors more than ground.

EXAMPLE_PWM.source: assumption: 3.3 V CMOS GPIO, no series R

calcs.note: replace with the design's own calculations; R('R1') reads a value from the netlist
